content.value: A wastewater treatment facility at the Greenfield Plan costs 9,00,000 TK to construct. It (15) [CO4] is projected to have 30-year life with an estimated salvage value of 10% of the construct cost. However, the facility will book depreciated to 30,000 over recovery period of 25 years. Calculate the annual depreciation for years 5, 15, and 30 using:
iii) DDB with Implied Salvage Value.
(Answer ANY THREE questions from this section in Script B)
